mapper.sql: id, original_name, object_key, file_size, file_md5, content_type, bucket_name, upload_status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file.t_file (id, original_name, object_key, file_size, file_md5, content_type, bucket_name, upload_status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{original_name}, #{object_key}, #{file_size}, #{file_md5}, #{content_type}, #{bucket_name}, #{upload_status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM file.t_file WHERE file_md5 = #{file_md5} AND upload_status != 2 ORDER BY upload_status DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE file.t_file SET upload_status = #{upload_status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE file.t_file SET upload_status = 2, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM file.t_file WHERE upload_status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
